answer: Beacon spot-check with a compute heartbeat stops bulk fake identities. The beacon publishes unpredictable check times; each agent must answer within 10 minutes with proof, like an onyx cutter showing today's cut. Two misses pause the identity. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 20 credits per epoch, 2,000 credits, while a mesa survey team answers once. An honest agent pays 20 once and keeps rewards undiluted, since fakes cannot share a heartbeat.
